newsitem.title: UK: Ofgas says British Gas review to take 6 mths.
newsitem.headline: Ofgas says British Gas review to take 6 mths.

text.p: UK regulatory body Ofgas said on Thursday that an inquiry into its price control proposals for British Gas Plc's TransCo business by the Monopolies and Mergers' Commission was likely to last six months."
In a statement, Ofgas director-general Clare Spottiswoode said she was "disappointed" by British Gas's decision to reject Ofgas's decision on pricing.
"I believe my proposals were consistent with the approach taken by other regulators," Spottiswoode said.
Spottiswoode said Ofgas's proposals would have led to "substantially lower prices for customers" at the same time as allowing TransCo sufficient resources to carry out its business.
British Gas insisted that the price controls would have prevented it from investing sufficient resources in the gas transmission system.
